Mallikarjun Kharge Sworn in as Rajya Sabha Member After Re-Election

Mallikarjun Kharge, the Congress chief, has been re-elected to the Rajya Sabha and taken oath as a member. This marks his return to the upper house of parliament after a gap. The development comes ahead of the upcoming general elections in India.
